Topology Mode for the Coroot Service Map is here! Huge thanks to our #opensource community member Jan Bukva for contributing.

View applications and their dependencies as an interactive graph to explore complex environments. Then, hover over a service to highlight its connections and see key metrics: https://github.com/coroot/coroot
